**I can't say whether tree cover changed in 2026.** The Hansen annual series only runs from 2001 to 2025, so it has no 2026 observations, even though this run was made in November 2026.

The tool output also includes no loss or gain events for any year, including 2021-2025. It only gives baseline figures for this 374.8 ha property:

- **2000:** about 48.4 ha of tree cover (at least 30% canopy), per Hansen.
- **2020:** about 43.3 ha of forest (11.55% of the property), per JRC GFC2020.

Hansen data covers the whole property (valid data fraction 1.0). The 2000 and 2020 figures come from different datasets, so they shouldn't be read as a measured change.

To answer for 2026, you would need a data source that covers 2026, such as a later release of the Hansen series. To answer for 2021-2025, the change-detection results would need to be returned.
